children: Taneja Vaibhav, an officer serving as Chief Financial Officer, reported a sale of common stock on September 8, 2026. The shares were sold at $360.134 per share. The total reported sale amount was $938,149. Following the transaction, the reporting person directly owned 25,972 shares and indirectly owned 111,000 shares (55,500 held in GRATs by the reporting person as trustee and 55,500 held in GRATs by the reporting person's spouse as trustee).
